summary: All four native cells are terminal and reproducible from the retained raw artifacts. Past-only obligation creation/release, actual victim handling, pool reservation, original LTR accounting, exact plan replay, full-cost denominators, independent policy state, and all 7556 planner/ledger steps verified. One P2 documentation issue remains: preparation-era UNRUN metadata and inherited campaign prose coexist with the clearly identified terminal execution contract.

findings.title: Preparation-era status and inherited campaign prose remain visible
findings.description: REPORT.md, EXECUTION_CONTRACT_ADDENDUM.md, and qualification metadata preserve the pre-execution UNRUN/NOT_YET_RUN state, while campaign.json retains an inherited rank-prefix/fit-scan question and interpretation. The actual cell list, comparison type, CLI, config, returned hashes, RESULTS_ADDENDUM.md, analysis, and execution state consistently identify the restore-completion campaign.

findings.required_action: Use RESULTS_ADDENDUM.md, analysis/REPORT.md, analysis/analysis.json, and execution/execution.json as the canonical terminal state. Preserve historical raw/preparation artifacts.
